meta.author: Elysium, Wrath Designs
meta.description: Released in late 2020 by the demo groups Elysium and Wrath Designs, To Norah is a one-file demo for the Commodore 64 designed for systems equipped with two SID sound chips. Its soundtrack makes extensive use of the additional audio capabilities provided by the dual-SID configuration, including a convincing simulation of a Hammond organ.
